observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 111.» (L11) in the left margin.
body L10, L11: the words from «et quem» to «esse» are italic (the words that note 6 says Plato lacks).
body L16: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic.
body L19: the hyphen of «oppo-» is printed short, as a point at mid height; so is the hyphen of «un-» in note 2.
body L3, L12: a speck stands at the top after the m of «Eadem», and another after «respondens»; neither is a sign.
notes_left L4: the letter of «adn. b» is bold italic.
notes_right L3: a point stands before «(6)»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L7: the breathing and the accent of «ὑπό-» are printed joined to their letters.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
